أستتر (form VIII)
# أَسْتَتِرُ (ʔastatiru) /ʔas.ta.ti.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَتَرَ (istatara)
# أَسْتَتِرَ (ʔastatira) /ʔas.ta.ti.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَتَرَ (istatara)
# أَسْتَتِرْ (ʔastatir) /ʔas.ta.tir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَتَرَ (istatara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
